name: How often should I repaint the interior of my home?

mainEntity.name: How often should I repaint the interior of my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency of interior repainting depends on various factors, including the room's use, traffic, and your lifestyle. High-traffic areas like hallways, kitchens, and bathrooms may need repainting every 3-5 years due to wear and tear or moisture. Bedrooms and living areas typically last 5-7 years, while less-used spaces like formal dining rooms might only need a refresh every 7-10 years. Consider repainting sooner if you notice fading, chips, or want to update your home's aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most interior rooms should be repainted every 3-10 years, depending on traffic and use. High-traffic areas wear faster, while less-used spaces can last longer.
